description: RS-2001 Gallery curatorial metadata. Each entry names one examples/*.rhs fixture already covered by examples/manifest.json and examples/baselines.json. Deliberately NOT stored here: stoneCount, objectType (product), thumbnail -- these are derived at load time from baselines.json / the fixture's own `product` field / the live render pipeline by src/gallery/GalleryCatalog.js, so they can never drift out of sync with the fixture's real, committed geometry. Gallery items are read-only; this file only adds curatorial labels on top of existing, unmodified fixtures.

items.title: Classic Name
items.description: The original preserved fixture: a short name in block font, centerline (outline) sampling. The simplest possible starting point.

items.title: Two-Word Name, Auto-Fit
items.description: A longer two-word name with Auto Fit enabled; comfortably within the canvas already, so the rescale pass never actually engages.

items.title: Short Name, Light Cup
items.description: A short first name in block font on a light cream cup, front wrap.

items.title: Long Name, Wide Wrap
items.description: A single name set at a height that forces auto-fit rescaling, on a dark navy cup with a wide wrap.

items.title: Script Name
items.description: A name set in the Great Vibes script font on a white cup -- a softer, more decorative look than the block font.

items.title: Three-Letter Monogram (Outline)
items.description: A three-letter monogram in block font, centerline sampling, on a small square canvas and a black cup.

items.title: Two-Letter Monogram (Fill)
items.description: A two-letter monogram with dense interior fill sampling instead of an outline -- a bolder, denser look.

items.title: Front Wrap, Light Cup
items.description: Dedicated front-wrap and light (white) cup combination, short name in block font.

items.title: Wide Wrap, Dark Cup
items.description: Dedicated wider-wrap and dark (black) cup combination, short name in block font.

items.title: Circle Only
items.description: A single circle shape layer with no text -- full wrap, navy cup. Good starting point for badge/logo layouts.

items.title: Rectangle Only
items.description: A single rectangle shape layer with no text -- half wrap, gray cup.

items.title: Text Framed by a Circle
items.description: A text layer plus an overlapping circle frame layer, demonstrating cross-layer stone de-duplication where the two meet.

items.title: Text Framed by a Rectangle
items.description: A text layer plus a rectangle frame layer, wide wrap, pink cup.

items.title: Text, Circle, and Rectangle
items.description: Text, circle, and rectangle layers together, with one layer hidden -- shows how hidden layers are excluded from the rendered design.

items.title: Small Stones, Tight Gap
items.description: Small 0.8mm stones with a tight 0.1mm gap -- a fine, dense look.

items.title: Large Stones, Wide Gap
items.description: Large 3.0mm stones with a wide 1.5mm gap -- a bold, sparse look, faster to apply by hand.

items.title: Long Script Name
items.description: A two-word name in Great Vibes script at a height that forces auto-fit, wide wrap, cream cup.

items.title: Imported SVG Logo
items.description: A badge logo (circle/star/ribbon) imported from SVG, with a text tagline layer underneath, gold fill mode.

items.title: Traced Photo Monogram
items.description: A monogram traced from a real photo/PNG using Image Trace, contour fill mode, on a white cup.

items.title: Boolean Union Badge
items.description: Two overlapping circles combined with a real Union boolean operation into a single badge shape.

items.title: Five-Layer Multi-Color Design
items.description: Five layers -- rectangles, circles, and text -- each in a distinct crystal color, on a black cup.

items.title: Tumbler Wrap Design
items.description: A Straight Tumbler product, half wrap, script name framed by an accent ring.

items.title: Bottle Label Design
items.description: A Bottle product, front wrap, label border framing a brand name and tagline.

items.title: Every Fill Style, Every Stone Size
items.description: The Gallery's largest fixture: five layers spanning every fill/text mode (outline/fill/staggered/radial/contour) and stone sizes from 1.0mm to 2.5mm. Used as the primary performance benchmark project.

items.title: Bride Tribe Tumbler
items.description: A script 'Bride Tribe' design framed by a full accent ring on a blush half-wrap tumbler -- a bachelorette/bridal-party favorite.

items.title: Team Name Mug
items.description: A bold filled team name and number nameplate with an underline accent bar -- a team-spirit mug design.

items.title: Corporate Branded Bottle
items.description: A company name framed by a rectangular label border on a navy front-wrap bottle -- corporate gifting and branded merchandise.
